> 第一章 云起（第1页）
仙河小镇，一个曾经让无数人无比向往的地方。
结果时间却让无数人慢慢地忘记这个地方，然而正是因为这样，它只是存在于历史长河之中。
随着这一声，一个大约是二岁多小孩，犹如一个脱缰的野马一般上蹿下跳的，他的身后一直跟着一个中年妇女，她大声叫道。
这个小孩仿佛并不是第一次这样做了，他身体极度灵敏，那个中年妇女根本就没有办法跟上他的步伐，她只能气喘吁吁地跟着“小豆子”。
到最后，她还是没有办法跟上“小豆子”，她只能插住双手，她大骂道：“小豆子，你再偷一次我的兽肉，我保证不打死你！”
此时另外一个中年汉子笑道：“花婶，小豆子，又偷吃你什么东西啦？”
“这个小豆子真的是让我头疼，你说他只是一个两岁的小孩，单单是这个月就已经偷吃了我们家上百斤兽肉，他怎么能够吃得了呢？”
在场的人听到花婶的话，无一不觉得震惊的。
事出突然必有妖的，单纯一个二岁多的小孩子，一个月顶多就是能够吃个二三十斤肉，可是现在小豆子却是巨大的食肉怪！
此时“小豆子”正依偎在一个头发已经发白的老头身上，那位老头正伸出手抚摸“小豆子”的头，他笑着说：“小豆子，你这个月已经偷吃了那么多肉，还叫饿啊！”
此时“小豆子”露出尴尬的微笑，他继续依偎着那个老头的身上。
老头此刻的心里却是非常之复杂的，他心里道：小豆子，你根本就不属于这里，真正属于你的舞台，也许老头我真的无法看到了。
整个小村庄除了老头子根本就没有人知道小豆子的来历，他们都是属于外来人，但是老头子精通医术，很快就得到了村人的认可，成为为数不多的医者。
所以就算是“小豆子”犯下任何的错，大家都不怪罪于他的。
“小豆子，不会的，如果顺利，你将可以打开天灵盖，成为真正的灵武者。”
“爷爷，是不是和蚕虫他们那样呢？”
那个老头不由得轻轻地感叹一声，只是声音非常之小，就连躺在他身边的小豆子都没有察觉到。
因为老者曾经在小豆子刚刚出现在他身边，也就是小豆子不到六个月时，帮助他打开天灵盖，结果却是失败，反而将他的修为强行破坏掉，使得他一夜之间头发发白，同时更加重要的事情就是他已经断送自己的修为。
老者知道这一次将是他最后一次希望，一旦再次失败，不旦小豆子的修行堵上了，就连他也会命不久矣！
可是他一点也不因此而害怕了，他反而更加坦然地面对的，他有时候想想当年的自己，他万万没有想到自己会有这样的一天。
居然能够做到为了一个人，可以付出那么多，只是因此，此次他已经做好充分准备，他所有准备好的一切都是最好的药材。
他明明知道这一次将会是最后的一次的机会，他绝对不会让自己有任何的遗憾，万一真的失败之后，他将一点机会都没有了。
“小豆子，给我出来，我就不相信你能够躲上一辈子！”

> Chapter 1 Clouds Rises (Page 1)
Xianhe Town, a place that countless people once yearned for.
As a result, time has made countless people slowly forget this place. However, precisely because of this, it only exists in the long river of history.
Following this sound, a child about two years old jumped up and down like a wild horse, followed by a middle-aged woman who shouted loudly.
It seemed that this was not the first time this child had done this. His body was extremely sensitive, and the middle-aged woman had no way of keeping up with him. She could only follow "Little Douzi" panting.
In the end, she still couldn't keep up with "Xiaodouzi". She could only put her hands in her hands and cursed: "Xiaodouzi, if you steal my animal meat again, I promise not to beat you to death!"
At this time, another middle-aged man smiled and said: "Aunt Hua, Xiaodouzi, did you steal something from you again?"
"This little Douzi really gives me a headache. You said he is only a two-year-old child. He has eaten hundreds of kilograms of animal meat in our house this month alone. How can he be able to eat it?"
Everyone present was shocked when they heard Aunt Hua's words.
When things happen suddenly, there must be monsters. A child over two years old can eat at most twenty or thirty pounds of meat in a month, but now Xiaodouzi is a huge carnivorous monster!
At this time, "Little Douzi" was clinging to an old man with gray hair. The old man was reaching out to stroke "Little Douzi"'s head. He smiled and said, "Little Douzi, you have eaten so much meat secretly this month, and you are still hungry!"
At this time, "Little Douzi" smiled awkwardly and continued to cling to the old man.
The old man's heart was very complicated at this moment. He said in his heart: Xiaodouzi, you don't belong here at all. The stage that really belongs to you, maybe I really can't see it anymore, old man.
No one in the entire small village knew the origin of Xiaodouzi except the old man. They were all outsiders. However, the old man was proficient in medical skills and quickly gained recognition from the villagers and became one of the few doctors.
So even if "Little Douzi" makes any mistakes, no one will blame him.
"Xiaodouzi, no, if everything goes well, you will be able to open the Tianling Cap and become a true spiritual warrior."
"Grandpa, are you like Silkworm and the others?"
The old man couldn't help but sigh softly, but his voice was so low that even Xiaodouzi lying next to him didn't notice it.
Because the old man once helped Xiaodouzi open the Tianling Cap when Xiaodouzi first appeared next to him, that is, when Xiaodouzi was less than six months old, but the result was a failure. Instead, he forcibly destroyed his cultivation, making his hair turn white overnight. At the same time, the more important thing was that he had ruined his own cultivation.
The old man knew that this time would be his last hope. If he failed again, not only would Xiaodouzi's practice be blocked, but he would also die soon!
But he was not afraid at all because of this. Instead, he faced it more calmly. Sometimes he thought about himself back then, and he never thought that he would have such a day.
He was able to pay so much for one person, but because of this, he was fully prepared this time, and everything he prepared was the best medicine.
He clearly knows that this time will be the last chance, and he will never let himself have any regrets. If he really fails, he will have no chance at all.
"Xiaodouzi, come out, I don't believe you can hide for the rest of your life!"
